summary: The native Android release build writes the symbol tables of its bundled native libraries into the AAB (ndk.debugSymbolLevel SYMBOL_TABLE), so Play can symbolicate native crash reports. mobile-release.yml fails when the AAB has no BUNDLE-METADATA debug symbols, and uploads the R8 mapping.txt to Play when one exists (R8 is off today, so none is uploaded). No app behaviour changes.

desktop.reason: Only the native Android release build and its workflow change; the desktop app is not touched.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo iOS app and its OTA lane are not touched.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No backend or wire protocol change.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes; the symbols live only in the AAB metadata that Play reads.

automated: tests/unit/android-native-ci.test.ts checks the symbol level, the BUNDLE-METADATA check and the mapping upload in the workflow.
notExercised: A signed bundleRelease AAB and the Play upload (the upload keystore and PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON exist only in CI).
A symbolicated native crash report in the Play Console.
